about_short_description.short_description: A healthcare organisation in the business of commercialising novel medicines, medical devices and molecular diagnostics in Oncology.

product.name: MejorAsp® PEG L-Asparaginase Injection
product.description: A PEGylated L-Asparaginase injection used in multi-agent chemotherapy for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia patients hypersensitive to asparaginase.

product.name: PEG-NUSTIM® Pegfilgrastim Injection
product.description: A long-acting pegfilgrastim injection to reduce febrile neutropenia risk in patients undergoing myelosuppressive chemotherapy.

product.name: RasCase® Rasburicase Injection
product.description: An intravenous rasburicase injection approved for prevention and treatment of Tumor Lysis Syndrome in cancer patients.

product.name: Personalised Medicine in Oncology
product.description: Genetic testing and precision therapies tailored to individual cancer patients based on their genetic profiles to improve treatment outcomes.

product.name: Clinical Research and Regulatory Services
product.description: Conducting clinical trials and managing regulatory approvals to bring novel oncology therapies to Indian and South Asian markets.

product.name: Commercialization and Market Access Services
product.description: Sales, marketing, and market access support to position and distribute novel oncology and rare disease therapies in India and the SAARC region.
